# About RASIRC RASIRC specializes in products that generate and deliver gas to fabrication processes. Each unit is a dynamic gas plant in a boxconverting common liquid chemistries into safe and reliable gas flow for most processes. RASIRC technology delivers water vapor, hydrogen peroxide gas and hydrazine gas in controlled, repeatable concentrations. RASIRC gas delivery systems, humidifiers, and closed loop humidification systems are critical for many applications in semiconductor, photovoltaic, pharmaceutical, medical, biological, fuel cell, and power industries. ![](<5c6a9a49aa695871b1f1ce950b2dfc9478c5_pg4_images/imageFile1.png>) RASIRC Page 4
